Title: Azure Data Share in US Gov Arizona and Virginia regions

Body.Content:
Azure Data Share is now generally available to Azure Government customers in the US Gov Virginia and US Gov Arizona regions. Azure Data Share service enables organization to share data easily and securely within their organization or with third parties. US government, public sector, and their partners can now use Azure Data Share service to easily and securely share data within the Azure Government cloud. 

Learn more about Azure Data Share service:

  • Azure Data Share videos

  • Azure Data Share product web page 

  • docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/data-share/ 

Learn more about Azure Government:

  • Azure Government cloud
